scripts.check: pnpm --filter @tempoxyz/earn check && pnpm --filter app check && vp lint --deny-warnings e2e localnet vite.config.ts && vp fmt --check '.github/**' README.md earn/README.md spend/README.md router/README.md SKILL.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md 'docs/**' '**/AGENTS.md' '!**/lib/**' 'profiles/**' 'e2e/**' 'localnet/**' vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
